content: MCP Registry publishing (primary quickstart read + search cross-check): PREVIEW (breaking changes/data resets possible before GA). mcp-publisher CLI (brew install mcp-publisher or release binary): init/login github (device flow)/publish/validate/status; CI login github-oidc with id-token:write. server.json:  2025-12-11, name reverse-DNS exactly one slash 3-200 chars; GitHub auth requires io.github.<user-or-org>/<name>; description <=100 chars; version unique+immutable per publish; packages[] (registryType npm/pypi/nuget/oci/mcpb, identifier, version, transport stdio, environmentVariables) or remotes[] (streamable-http public URL). Registry hosts METADATA only — package must be published first. Ownership verification: npm mcpName in package.json; PyPI/NuGet = 'mcp-name: <server-name>' line or HTML comment in package README. Verify: curl registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers?search=<name>. No human review; spam/malware removal only.
